_comment: 짧은 한마디(바크) v1 — 과장 초안(2026-10-19). 감정 이름은 PortraitEmotion 순서(neutral, happy, anxious, angry, shocked, sad, relieved). 인물마다 감정당 두 개.

edwin.design: A Korean man in his mid twenties, a bookish scholar. Soft, clear tenor, calm and thoughtful, slightly dry humor, speaks precisely.
edwin.ref_text: 음, 기록을 다시 맞춰 보자. 숫자는 거짓말을 하지 않으니까.

kaira.design: A Korean woman in her early twenties, a sword fighter and vanguard. Crisp, confident, slightly low voice, quick and blunt, energetic.
kaira.ref_text: 앞은 내가 맡을게. 넌 뒤에서 내 등만 봐.

elaria.design: A Korean woman who sounds ageless and mature, an elven mage. Soft, smooth, elegant mezzo voice, slow and composed, faintly amused.
elaria.ref_text: 별이 기울면 마력도 흐름을 바꾸지요. 서두를 필요는 없어요.

godric.design: A Korean man in his late forties, a veteran shield warrior. Deep, warm, slightly gravelly baritone, hearty and steady, big laugh.
godric.ref_text: 걱정 마라. 이 방패가 버티는 한 아무도 못 지나간다.

fio.design: A Korean girl's voice for a small fairy healer, sounds young and tiny. High, bright, sweet and bubbly, quick, cheerful.
fio.ref_text: 다친 데 없어? 내가 금방 낫게 해 줄게!

innkeeper.design: A Korean woman in her fifties who runs a busy tavern. Warm, hearty, slightly husky alto, motherly but brisk.
innkeeper.ref_text: 자, 앉아. 국 식기 전에 먹고, 일은 그다음에 하자고.

archivist.design: A Korean man in his seventies, a guild records keeper. Thin, dry, quiet and precise voice, polite and formal, slightly hoarse.
archivist.ref_text: 기록은 남은 사람을 위해 쓰는 법입니다. 천천히 보시지요.

smith.design: A Korean man in his forties, a blacksmith. Deep, gruff, low voice, few words, blunt and rough.
smith.ref_text: 쇠는 거짓말을 안 해. 두드린 만큼만 버티지.

broker.design: A Korean man in his late twenties, a smooth market broker. Light, quick, friendly but sly voice, a bit smug.
broker.ref_text: 요즘 들어오는 모험단 소식이라면, 제가 제일 빠르죠.

steward.design: A Korean man in his fifties, a lord's steward. Formal, stiff, measured baritone, cold and polite.
steward.ref_text: 영주님께서는 지금 손님을 받지 않으십니다. 용건을 남기시지요.

informant.design: A hooded information dealer in an underground market, Korean. Low, hushed, husky voice close to a whisper, unhurried, secretive and slightly amused.
informant.ref_text: 소식은 공짜가 아니야. 하지만 오늘은… 맛보기로 하나 주지.
